Claim: PM loop round 8 (continued) — flight O, one governed objectui skills card: `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md`'s example plugin node interface (`MyWidgetSchema`) hand-rolls `BaseSchema`'s members instead of extending it and declares `hidden` / `disabled` as plain strings, so a copied declaration refuses `hidden: true` and the expression envelope the shipped renderer accepts. The seat's ruling: the example `extends BaseSchema` and keeps only the widget's own members; any member it still spells takes the real declaration (the amended #8092 test — a member stays only with a real reader). Same class as #8092 / #8065, fourth surface.
Session: `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`
Branch: `claude/issue-8103-plugin-guide-extends-baseschema`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-8103`
Domain: `domain:skills`
File surface: `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md` only (net-zero or net-negative lines). ⛔ No other file.
Container & model: XS, `mode:subagent`, opus — no `dispatch-gates.mjs` in objectui; prose in a published skill, no contract move.
Clause-②: no
Serial: no open PR touches this guide (PR #8104 holds `guides/architecture.md` + `rules/protocol.md`; PR #8091 holds `guides/schema-expressions.md`; PR #8090 holds root `AGENTS.md`). GOVERNED (`skills/**`) ⇒ draft PR, in-seat review, `os-zhuang` + `hotlong`, human merge; objectui has no `skip-changeset` label — the changeset gate decides; at ACCEPT the seat adds `needs-user-decision` + the 维护者速读. The PR carries `Fixes #8103`.
